propositions: Project code-review criteria must be documented in docs/llm-framework.md with a normative section containing four distinct #### subheadings covering fan-in, Pass-3 routing, eval resolution, and configuration errors.
Repository-effective project LLM criteria are injected exactly once into round_a and are not injected into round_b; each project finding retains its logical criterion id in the project.* namespace.

Pass-3 effective routing map governs deterministic threshold, blocking, advisory, and nit-suppression decisions for logical project ids; project code-review ids active in exactly one gate resolve through the criteria eval arm.

Activated project criteria with missing or invalid prompt/eval specifications must raise a located configuration error rather than silently falling back; unknown and cross-gate-ambiguous ids are rejected before calibration.
